description: This file defines the UserImportHandler class, which implements the ImportHandler interface for processing user data import from Excel workbooks into the system. It handles reading user data from Excel sheets, creating user entities, and invoking commands to create users while updating import status within the sheet.

classes.name: UserImportHandler
classes.description: A service class responsible for importing user data from an Excel workbook, processing each user, and creating users via command objects.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process the entire workbook, reading user data and importing entities.

methods.name: readExcelFile
methods.description: Reads user data from the specified sheet in the workbook, returning a list of AppUserData objects.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Reads individual user data from a row in the Excel sheet and constructs an AppUserData object.

methods.name: importEntity
methods.description: Iterates over collected user data to create users via commands, updating the sheet with import status.
